# dsh-compound-memory
English | 中文
DeepSeek Harness bundle that launches the existing compound-memory MCP server (`uvx --from compound-
memory compound-memory-server`), mounts the bundled `skills/compound-memory` skill, and injects a sh
ort once-per-session usage reminder. It does not reimplement memory, it does not add a sixth MCP too
l, and the server still has no LLM (ADR-0001). This wrapper adds none. There are no install, lifecyc
le, or `postinstall` scripts.
`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` = `./cordis.patch.yml`. That file inserts three rows: the
in-box `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row (`mcp-compound-memory`), this package's own plugin (`compo
und-memory-rules` → `dsh-compound-memory` → `index.js`), and an in-box `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-files
ystem` row (`compound-memory-skill`) whose only root is this package's `skills/`. Do not install tha
t client yourself: DSH 0.2 already ships it, and a separately installed 0.1 client will not match (d
iscussion #8202). This package declares no `@deepseek-ai/*` dependencies. The rules module does not
import `@deepseek-ai/cordis` or the MCP client: Cordis calls `apply(ctx)`, and the publish guide say
s to pin a peer only when the plugin must share that package's instance. `engines.dsh` is `>=0.2.0-r
c.1 <0.3.0-0` so current 0.2 prereleases match and 0.3 prereleases do not (publish guide, market ind
<0.3.0-0` so current 0.2 prereleases match and 0.3 prereleases do not (publish guide, market index).

`memory_search` returns an object whose `hits` field is an array.
## Install
Requires the `dsh` CLI and `uv` / `uvx` on the `PATH` of the process that starts `dsh`. The first `u
vx` run needs network access to fetch `compound-memory` from PyPI. `uv` supplies the tool's Python;
a system Python is not required.

## Environment
Set these on the process that launches `dsh`. The patch reads them with `!!js` when config loads. Un
set or blank uses the default. Nothing here is a secret. The stdio child starts from a scrubbed pare
nt environment; configured `env` is merged on top.
| Variable | Default when unset or blank |

| `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` | `agent-dsh` |
| `COMPOUND_MEMORY_ROOT` | `$HOME/.agents/memory` (opti
onal; the Python server expands a leading `$HOME` or `~`) |
`agent-dsh` is this host's stable id. Set `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` before starting `dsh` when this
process should be a different host. A later patch layer replaces the whole `config`. To point `comm
and` at an absolute `uvx`, restate the row in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (same fields: `
serverName`, `transport`, `command`, `args`, `env`, `failOnStartupError`).
## Usage reminder
`compound-memory-rules` listens on `agent/pre-step` with `{ prepend: true }`. On the first eligible
`enter` of a live agent (the decision is `enter` and the step signal is not aborted) it appends one
user-role message. Later steps of that agent do not append it again. A new agent object whose sessio
n log already contains the reminder (resume, or this process restarted) does not get a second copy.
The listener does not read the memory store and does not call a model (ADR-0001).
The message text is `RULES` in `index.js` (356 characters, under the 400-character Claude SessionSta
rt budget). It states:
- `COMPOUND_MEMORY_AGENT_ID` defaults to `agent-dsh` (overridable); pass that same id as `source` an

d `agent`
- `memory_search` before non-trivial work; `memory_feedback` after an adopted hit compound

s the store
- in a repo, prefer project-scoped memories
- five MCP tools only, named `mcp__compound-
memory__memory_*`; this package does not reimplement them
The source is `{ kind: 'plugin:dsh-compound-memory', form: 'instructions' }`, and the message has a
fresh `id`. Session format v4 rejects the retired `{ kind: 'plugin', plugin }` wrapper and fails the
whole turn (discussion #8432). `plugin:dsh-compound-memory` is the producer-owned kind the v3→v4 re
writer would derive for this package. A static `systemPrompt.section` was not required: pre-step acc
epts the message, and injecting once keeps it out of every later step.
### Disable the reminder
Stop only the reminder. In the profile patch (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`) or the home pa
tch (`$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`), add:

A later layer addresses the row by id. `disabled: true` stops that loader entry. `mcp-compound-memor
y` is a different id and still launches `uvx`. `compound-memory-skill` is a different id and still m
ounts the bundled skill. `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-compound-memory` removes all three row
nts the bundled skill. `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-compound-memory` removes all three rows.
### Verify
`dsh --profile web --dump-config` shows `mcp-compound-memory`, `compound-memory-rules`, and `compoun
d-memory-skill` under `# == dsh-compound-memory`.
Start a new session and send one message. The transcript should contain one user-role reminder whose
`source.kind` is `plugin:dsh-compound-memory` and whose text starts with `compound-memory:`. A late
r step in that same session should not add another copy. `node --test` in this repository checks the
listener without booting DSH.
